πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πύργον: πύργος — tower, bastion; masc. acc. sg.

σάκος: σάκος — shield; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’the shield’ (σάκος … ἀνεδέξατο ’the shield received’)
σέθεν: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σέθεν (= Attic σοῦ)
σεύατ: σεύω (mid. σεύομαι) — dart, rush, speed; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (σεύατ’ = σεύατο): ’sped, darted’
σθένος: σθένος — strength, might; neut. nom./acc. sg.
σιγῇ: σιγή — silence; fem. dat. sg., used adverbially: ’in silence’
στέρνοιο: στέρνον — chest, breast; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
συσὶ: σῦς — pig, boar; masc./fem. dat. pl., after ἐοικότες, with κάπροισιν: ’boars’
σφῶϊ: σφώ — you two; dual pron., epic σφῶϊ, acc.: ’you two’ · also nom. dual: ’you two’ (σφῶϊ μέν ’as for you two’)
σχέθον: ἔχω — hold, keep; aor. 3 pl., epic σχέθον (= ἔσχον): ’they held’
σύν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat., accented before the enclitic τε that follows · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σύν ῥ’ ἔβαλον = συνέβαλον ’dashed together’)
σῆμα: σῆμα — sign, mark; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’sign’ · also neut. acc. sg., predicate, with κικλήσκουσιν understood: ’tomb’ (σῆμα Μυρίνης ’the tomb of Myrine’) · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’a token’ (σῆμα ἰδέσθαι ’to see the token’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’tomb’ (ἀνδρὸς τόδε σῆμα ’the tomb of a man’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’) · also indefinite τίς with a negative: ’no one’ (οὐ γάρ τίς … ἀνήρ ’for no man’)
ταλαύρινον: ταλαύρινος — shield-enduring (τλῆναι + ῥινός; sense traditional), a standing epithet of Ares; masc. acc. sg.
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελαμώνιος: Τελαμώνιος — son of Telamon (patronymic adj.); masc. nom. sg.
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη)
τεύχων: τεύχω — make, fashion; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’making’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’)
τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοῖοι: τοῖος — such, of such a sort; masc. nom. pl.: ’of such a kind’
τοῖος: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. nom. sg. (τοῖος ... οἷον ’such as’)
τρόμος: τρόμος — trembling, quaking; masc. nom. sg.
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρῶές: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’, often with γε: ’that at least’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg., inner object: ’which’ (ἕλκος τό μιν βάλε ’the wound with which he struck him’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, ’on that account’ (τό γε δείδιθι ’fear not on that account’)
τύχωμι: τυγχάνω — hit (+ gen.), happen upon; aor. subj. 1 sg. in -μι, epic (= Attic τύχω): ’I may hit’
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’)
φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear’ · also neut. acc. pl., attributive: ’own’ (φίλα εἵματα ’his own clothes’) · also neut. acc. pl., ’dear’ (φίλα τέκνα ’dear children’) · also neut. acc. pl. as adverb: φίλα φρονέων ’kindly disposed’
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, friendly; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address: ’friends!’ · also masc. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear, welcome’ (μῦθοι φίλοι)
φαίδιμος: φαίδιμος — shining, glorious, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Hector · also epithet of Ajax (φαίδιμος Αἴας) · also epithet of Glaucus (φαίδιμος υἱός ’glorious son’)
φαεινῆς: φαεινός — shining, bright; adj., fem. gen. sg.
φιλεῖ: φιλέω — love, hold dear; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’loves’
φώνησέν: φωνέω — speak, utter; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable, accented before the enclitic τε

χαλκοχιτώνων: χαλκοχίτων — bronze-shirted, with bronze tunics; masc. gen. pl.

χαλκὸς: χαλκός — bronze, copper; also a bronze blade; masc. nom. sg.
χαμάδις: χαμάδις — to the ground, groundward; adv.
χεῖρ: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. sg., elided (χεῖρ’ = χεῖρα)
ἀγαθὸν: ἀγαθός — good; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(not) good’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a named man: ’good’ (πὺξ ἀγαθὸν Πολυδεύκεα ’Polydeuces, good with his fists’)
ἀγαμέμνονι: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. dat. sg.
ἀγλαὸν: ἀγλαός — splendid, bright, radiant; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν: ’splendid (son)’
ἀκρότατον: ἀκρότατος — topmost, outermost (superl. of ἄκρος); adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα
ἀλαπαδνόν: ἀλαπαδνός — feeble, weak; neut. nom. sg., predicate with σθένος
ἀλεύατο: ἀλέομαι — avoid, shun; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= Attic ἠλεύατο): ’avoided’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμπεπαλὼν: ἀναπάλλω — swing up, brandish; aor. 2 part. act., masc. nom. sg., reduplicated, ἀμ- by assimilation of ἀνά
ἀμφοτέροισι: ἀμφότερος — both (of two); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), after μετά: ’among both’
ἀμφοτέρω: ἀμφότερος — both; masc. acc. dual, agreeing with a dual noun: ’both’
ἀν: ἀνά (elided ἀν’) — up, along, through; prep. + acc.: ’up through, throughout’
ἀνέρας: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. pl., epic ἀνέρας (= Attic ἄνδρας)
ἀνεγνάμφθη: ἀναγνάμπτω — bend back; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was bent back’
ἀντικρὺ: ἀντικρύ — straight through, right through; adv. (epic, = ἀντικρύς) · also of fighting, ’head-on, face to face’ (ἀντικρὺ μάχεσθαι ’to fight head-on’)
ἀπέλεθρον: ἀπέλεθρος — immense, boundless; masc./fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἶν’: ’immeasurable’
ἀπομηνίσας: ἀπομηνίω — be wrathful, with ἀπο- of uncertain force (‘away’, ‘utterly’); aor. part. masc. nom. sg., + dat. ’at’: ’having withdrawn in wrath’
ἀργεῖοι: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Argives!’
ἀριστήεσσιν: ἀριστεύς — best man, chief; masc. dat. pl., epic -ήεσσιν (= Attic -εῦσιν)
ἀριστερὰ: ἀριστερός — left; neut. acc. pl., used adverbially with ἐπί: ’on the left (hand)’
ἀριστῆες: ἀριστεύς — best man, chief; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
ἀσπίδ: ἀσπίς — shield; fem. acc. sg., elided ἀσπίδ’
ἀσπίδι: ἀσπίς — shield; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’by his shield’
ἀτειρής: ἀτειρής — unwearied, unyielding; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with χαλκός: ’unwearied’
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.

ἄγετ: ἄγω — lead; pl. imper. ’come now!’, elided (ἄγετ’ = ἄγετε), addressed to a group · also ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided and unaugmented (ἄγετ’ = ἄγετο): ’brought for himself’ (of taking a bride)
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’
ἄνακτι: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. dat. sg.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄρης: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. nom. sg.
ἄρηϊ: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρει)
ἄριστος: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος ’best’; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἄρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead the way; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἦρχε): ’led the way’
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time, along; adv./prep. + dat.
ἅπαντες: ἅπας — all, every one; masc. nom. pl.
ἐΐσην: ἐΐσος — equal, balanced; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἀσπίδα: ’balanced, equal on all sides’
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐθέλω: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. 1 sg.
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκλίνθη: κλίνω — bend, lean; aor. pass. 3 sg. with middle sense: ’leaned aside’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνδέξια: ἐνδέξιος — to the right; neut. acc. pl. as adv.: ’rightwards, towards the right’

ἐοικότες: ἔοικα (perf. with pres. force) — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’like’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’)
ἐπέρεισε: ἐπερείδω — lean upon, press, put weight on; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’pressed home’
ἐπαΐξαι: ἐπαΐσσω — dart upon, rush at; aor. inf. act., used as an imperative: ’to dash at’
ἐπιδινήσας: ἐπιδινέω — whirl round; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’having whirled round’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’)
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἑκὼν: ἑκών — willing, of one’s own accord; adj., masc. nom. sg.: ’willingly’
ἑὸν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δῶμα: ’his own’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν: ’his own’
ἔγχεα: ἔγχος — spear; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic ἔγχη) · also neut. acc. pl., object: ’spears’ (ἔγχεα ὀξυόεντα ’sharp spears’)
ἔμπης: ἔμπης — nevertheless, in any case, for all that; adv.
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with accent thrown back after its noun (νέεσσ’ ἔνι = Attic ἐν ναυσί)
ἔπειθ: ἔπειτα — then, thereafter; adv., elided (ἔπειθ’ = ἔπειτα before a rough breathing)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔριδος: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contention; fem. gen. sg.
ἔρρηξεν: ῥήγνυμι — break, burst; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’broke’
ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., accented ἔστι at clause start: existential, ’there is’ · also impersonal + inf.: ’it is possible’ (οὐδέ πῃ ἔστι … εὐχετάασθαι)

ἔφαν: φημί — say; impf./aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔφασαν): ’they said’
ἕκαστον: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. acc. sg.: ’each (man)’
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.

ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορος: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam, chief Trojan hero; masc. gen. sg.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕρκος: ἕρκος — fence, barrier, bulwark; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἠΰτε: ἠΰτε — like as, even as; epic particle introducing a comparison
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠρήρειστο: ἐρείδω — press, fix, lodge; plpf. pass. 3 sg., epic reduplicated: ’was driven home’
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’)
ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl.: ’we’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤθελον: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; impf. 3 pl. (ἤθελον)
ἤλασε: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg.: ’drove, struck’
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἤϊε: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ᾔει)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’)
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἦλθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves 3 pl.): ’I came’
ἰδαῖος: Ἰδαῖος — Idaeus, herald of Priam; masc. nom. sg. · also Idaeus, a Trojan, son of Dares; masc. nom. sg.
ἰδών: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having seen’
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἱππότα: ἱππότα — horseman, charioteer (epithet of Nestor); masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α (= ἱππότης)
ἴδηθεν: Ἴδη — Mount Ida near Troy; Ἴδηθεν with suffix -θεν: ’from Ida’
ἴδμεν: οἶδα — know; pres. 1 pl., epic ἴδμεν (= Attic ἴσμεν): ’we know’
ἴσην: ἴσος — equal, even; fem. acc. sg.
ἵκανε: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg.: ’came to, reached’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj.
ἶν: ἴς — strength, force; fem. acc. sg. ἶνα, elided in the text (ἶν’)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄβριμον: ὄβριμος — mighty, heavy; adj. of two endings, masc./neut. acc. sg.
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’)
ὄχ: ὄχα — by far, exceedingly; adv., elided (ὄχ’ = ὄχα), intensifying a superlative (ὄχ’ ἄριστα ’far the best’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’)
ὅμιλον: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. acc. sg.
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὑμείων: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; gen. pl., epic ὑμείων (= Attic ὑμῶν): ’of you’
ὕλῃ: Ὕλη — Hyle, a town in Boeotia (the same word as ὕλη ’woodland’); fem. dat. sg., of place
ὕπτιος: ὕπτιος — on one’s back, face up; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ὠκειάων: ὠκύς — swift; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν); ἵππος is feminine when it means ’mare’
ὠμοφάγοισιν: ὠμοφάγος — eating raw flesh (ὠμός + φαγεῖν); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), agreeing with λείουσιν
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’rushed, started up’
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ὧς: ὥς — thus, so; adv. (printed ὧς, = ὣς; Attic οὕτως)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
